# Isaiah Chapter 42 -- The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

## Consensus Translation

*[Full consensus translation of all 25 verses]*

*First Servant Song; justice to nations; light to Gentiles; new song; blind and deaf servant*

---

## SOPHIA's Council Notes

Isaiah chapter 42 (The Servant of the LORD) addresses first servant song; justice to nations; light to gentiles; new song; blind and deaf servant. The key verse — "A bruised reed he will not break, and a faintly burning wick he will not quench" — captures the chapter's central message. This chapter belongs to Second Isaiah (chs. 40-55), focused on comfort, restoration, and the servant figure.
